tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Open a Rooms Agent Pay room for a goal with a budget (USD) and an approval line. Returns one ready-to-pay link the human opens to fund it with PayPal or a card (SANDBOX: no real money). Unspent budget stays in the room as credit for the next hire.

tools.name: room_status
tools.description: Room balance, spent, fees, refundable amount, hires and the latest transcript lines.

tools.name: hire_specialist
tools.description: Hire a house specialist (research, copy or design) for a brief, paid from the room balance. Runs immediately and settles after verification, unless the price is over the approval line (then it waits for approve_hire).

tools.name: approve_hire
tools.description: Approve a hire that is over the approval line; it then runs and is paid from the room balance after verification.

tools.name: decline_hire
tools.description: Decline a hire that is waiting for approval. No money moves.

tools.name: close_room
tools.description: Close the current mission. The unspent balance stays in the room as credit for next time (no automatic refund).

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: Owner asks for the refundable balance back (within the refund window of funding, minus the PayPal processing fee). Reviewed and approved manually by Rooms.

tools.name: sandbox_fund_with_test_card
tools.description: SANDBOX ONLY: fund the room headlessly with a PayPal sandbox test card (for automated tests). Disabled in live mode.
